avoid(bad): 製品安全情報 / 製品安全に関する情報
rule_note: Official Japan GVP (Ord.135) term for 'safety management information'. LOCK. Vendor used literal calque.
Company name in katakana within Japanese prose. Keep Latin ONLY inside official English document titles.

avoid(bad): 製品安全に関する啓発 / 製品安全啓発
rule_note: Keep the defined program name in English. Do not descriptively translate.

avoid(bad): 患者 (bare, when referring to patients)
rule_note: Respectful honorific for patients in JP healthcare register. Bare 患者 reads clinical/cold.

avoid(bad): はじめに (as a section heading)
rule_note: House style: section headings mirror the English via katakana. CONFIRM with in-country owner (preference, not correctness).
